remarks: Step into this spacious 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse, featuring an additional upper-level loft, a finished lower level, and an attached garage. The first floor offers an open-concept design with an eat-in kitchen that includes a balcony and new stainless steel appliances, a combined living and dining area, a half bath, and elegant hardwood and vinyl flooring throughout. The second floor comprises two bedrooms and a full bath, with the bright master bedroom boasting a walk-in closet and vaulted ceiling. The carpeted third-floor loft adds flexible living space, while the finished lower level provides ample storage, laundry facilities, and access to the garage. This pet-friendly condo is ideally situated near the pool, a recently renovated clubhouse, and a fitness center. Conveniently located just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, Springdale shopping, dining options, and both the Springdale and Talmadge Hill train stations, this home is the perfect blend of comfort and accessibility.
